description:
Set CPU / memory limits on the stack's services (docker-compose.override.yml) and recreate
    the services named, so they take effect. Use it when a stack runs NEXT TO PRODUCTION on the
    same box (a test copy of a large database can otherwise take every core and all RAM).
    `limits` = {service|major|'db': {"cpus": 2, "mem": "6g", "mem_reservation": "4g"}}; the
    file holds ONLY limits and is replaced as a whole (the previous one is kept as .bak-<ts>), so
    pass every service you want limited. A service the stack does not have is refused. Recreating
    restarts those containers (seconds). dry_run shows the file and the script. An existing
    override with other settings (environment, ports...) is refused unless replace_other_keys=true
    - move them into docker-compose.yml first, or they are lost (a backup is kept).
name: docker_stack_limits
